items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, I keep thinking Teschma ker

ctx.x: Yeah, right. Thank you for your great defense. I think that's good. We're sitting on opposite sides of the fence and I'm on the side you're talking about, only as a senior citizen now. But I'm concerned with -- I've listened to Prez, when he was living, talk about how he was influenced by some great white players like the great saxophone player that was with Paul Whiteman's band that played C melody saxophone.
Yeah, I keep thinking Teschma ker
It wasn't Teschma ker. It was the guy who recorded with Bix Beiderbecke all the time.
